## Occurrence Data

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Sign in using ALA email
galah_config(email = "yourname@email.com")

# Get occurences from ALA
occ <- galah_call() |>
  galah_identify("Austropuccinia psidii") |>
  galah_filter(year >= 2010,
               basisOfRecord == c("HumanObservation","Occurrence"),
               country == "Australia",
               profile = "ALA") |>
  galah_select(
    "recordID",
    "dataResourceName",
    "scientificName",
    "decimalLatitude",
    "decimalLongitude",
    "country",
    "eventDate",
    "basisOfRecord",
    "individualCount",
    "coordinateUncertaintyInMeters",
    "institutionCode",
    "collectionCode"
  ) |>
  atlas_occurrences(mint_doi = TRUE)

# See DOI
attr(occ, "doi")

# Generate citation
citation <- atlas_citation(occ)

write.csv(occ, "data/raw/APsidii_ALA_250929.csv")
occ <- read.csv("data/raw/APsidii_ALA_250729.csv")

# Clean and analyse occurrences -------------------------------------------

# Flag occurrences with CoordinateCleaner
occ_cleaner <- clean_coordinates(
  x = occ,
  lon = "decimalLongitude",
  lat = "decimalLatitude",
  species = "scientificName",
  tests = c("centroids", "equal", "institutions", "zeros", "capitals", "duplicates")
)

# View flagged results
table(occ_cleaner$.summary)

# Create a new object with only unflagged occurrences
occ_clean <- occ_cleaner %>% 
  filter(.summary == TRUE)
write.csv(occ_clean, "data/processed/APsidii_ALA_250729_cleaned.csv")
occ_clean <- read.csv("data/processed/APsidii_ALA_250729_cleaned.csv")

# Analyse coordinate uncertainty
summary(occ_clean$coordinateUncertaintyInMeters)

coord_unc <- occ_clean |>
  dplyr::select(dataResourceName, coordinateUncertaintyInMeters) |>
  filter(is.na(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters))

# Density plot of coordinate uncertainty
ggplot(occ_clean, aes(x = coordinateUncertaintyInMeters)) +
  geom_density(fill = "lightgreen", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(9000, 4500, 1000), linetype = "dashed", color = c("red", "orange", "green")) +
  annotate("text", x = 9000, y = 0, label = "9 km", color = "red", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, hjust = -5) +
  annotate("text", x = 4500, y = 0, label = "4.5 km", color = "orange", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, hjust = -5) +
  annotate("text", x = 1000, y = 0, label = "1 km", color = "green", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, hjust = -5) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  labs(
    x = expression("Coordinate Uncertainty (log"[10] ~ "m)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())

# Define thresholds for uncertainty in meters
threshold_5min <- 9000    # ~9 km for 5 minutes
threshold_2_5min <- 4500  # ~4.5 km for 2.5 minutes
threshold_30sec <- 1000  # ~1 km for 30 seconds

# Calculate proportions
total_records <- nrow(occ_clean)

prop_below_5min <- mean(occ_clean$coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= threshold_5min, na.rm = TRUE)
prop_below_2_5min <- mean(occ_clean$coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= threshold_2_5min, na.rm = TRUE)
prop_below_30sec <- mean(occ_clean$coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= threshold_30sec, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filter datasets by thresholds
occ_2_5min <- occ_clean |>
  filter(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= threshold_2_5min | is.na(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters))
occ_30sec <- occ_clean |>
  filter(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= threshold_30sec | is.na(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters))

## Create coordinate only data
# 2.5-minute resolution (≤ 4.5 km uncertainty)
occ_2_5min_coords <- occ_2_5min %>%
  select(decimalLongitude, decimalLatitude)
# 30-second resolution (≤ 1 km uncertainty)
occ_30sec_coords <- occ_30sec %>%
  select(decimalLongitude, decimalLatitude)

## Create an object for both as df
# Converting 2.5minute res to dataframe
occ_2_5min_df <- as.data.frame(occ_2_5min_coords)
write.csv(occ_2_5min_df, "data/processed/APsidii_ALA_2_5min_df.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# Converting 30second res to dataframe
occ_30sec_df <- as.data.frame(occ_30sec_coords)
write.csv(occ_30sec_df, "data/processed/APsidii_ALA_30sec_df.csv", row.names = FALSE)
occ_30sec_df <- read.csv("data/processed/APsidii_ALA_30sec_df.csv")

## Make them spatial data for mapping
# Converting 2.5minute res to spatial object
occ_2_5min_sf <- st_as_sf(occ_2_5min_coords, coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = 4326)
# Converting 30second res to spatial object
occ_30sec_sf <- st_as_sf(occ_30sec_coords, coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = 4326)
```

### Visualisation

```{r}
# load in aus shp - STATES AND TERRITORIES AVAILABLE HERE: https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/access-and-downloads/digital-boundary-files#downloads-for-gda2020-digital-boundary-files
aus_states <- st_read("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-TheUniversityofMelbourne/R Projects/Susceptibility mapping/data/spatial/STE_2021_AUST_GDA2020.shp")
# in albers
states_alb <- st_transform(aus_states, crs = "EPSG:3577")
# drop islands
states_alb <- st_crop(states_alb,       
                    xmin = -1.95e6, xmax = 2.5e6,
                    ymin = -5e6, ymax = -1e6)

# occurence as shape
occurrence_sf <- st_as_sf(occ_30sec_df, coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = 4326)
# in albers equal area
occ_30sec_alb <- st_transform(occurrence_sf, crs = "EPSG:3577")

# Spatial join: assign each occurrence to its state
occ_in_states <- st_join(occ_30sec_alb, states_alb)

# Summarise counts and percentages
occ_count_by_state <- occ_in_states |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(STE_NAME21, name = "n_occurrences") |>
  mutate(perc_total = round(100 * n_occurrences / sum(n_occurrences), 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(n_occurrences))

# View results
print(occ_count_by_state)

# plotting
occ_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states_alb, fill = "grey") +  # Add the shapefile as a base layer
  geom_sf(data = occ_30sec_alb, color = "red", size = 1) + # Add occurrence points
  labs(title = "Occurrence Data Used in MaxEnt model") +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr", which_north = "true",
                         style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering) +
  theme_minimal() # Optional: customize the plot theme
occ_map
```

## Setting up Predictor Variables

```{r}
#| echo: false
# 30s bioclim for aus
bioAUS <- worldclim_country("Australia", var = "bio", path = "data/raw")
bioAUS <- rast("data/raw/climate/wc2.1_country/AUS_wc2.1_30s_bio.tif")

# 30s for aus
sradAUS <- worldclim_country("Australia", var = "srad", path = "data/raw")

# Forest data for AUS
# Available here: https://www.agriculture.gov.au/abares/forestsaustralia/forest-data-maps-and-tools/spatial-data/forest-cover
forAUS <- rast("data/raw/Forest data/aus_for23.tif")

# Reproject to WGS 84
forAUS_wgs84 <- project(forAUS, "EPSG:4326")
cats(forAUS_wgs84)

writeRaster(forAUS_wgs84, "data/processed/Forest data/forestcovercode.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
forAUS_wgs84 <- rast("data/processed/Forest data/forestcovercode.tif")

# Getting the distance from initial incursion
# Using Australian LGA data can get LGA from central coast as there is no specific point data
# LGA available at: https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3/jul2021-jun2026/access-and-downloads/digital-boundary-files#downloads-for-gda2020-digital-boundary-files
LGAs <- st_read("data/raw/LGA_2025_AUST_GDA2020")
# Reproject to wgs84
LGAs_wgs84 <- st_transform(LGAs, "EPSG:4326")
# Select only central coast LGA
central_coast <- LGAs_wgs84 %>%
  filter(LGA_NAME25 == "Central Coast (NSW)") %>%
  select(AREASQKM)


# Make a sample raster for the distance
sample_raster <- rast(nrows = nrow(bioAUS),
                      ncols = ncol(bioAUS),
                      extent = ext(bioAUS),
                      crs = crs(bioAUS))

# Rasterize central coast polygon
CentCoast_raster <- rasterize(central_coast, bioAUS, field = 1)
writeRaster(CentCoast_raster, "data/processed/centralcoastraster.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
# Create the distance from initial incursion area raster
dist_frm_initial <- distance(CentCoast_raster, unit = "km")
writeRaster(dist_frm_initial, "data/processed/distfromincurs.tif")
dist_frm_initial <- rast("data/processed/distfromincurs.tif")
dist_frm_initial_m <- mask(dist_frm_initial, bioAUS[[1]])
names(dist_frm_initial_m) <- "Distance (km)"
writeRaster(dist_frm_initial_m, "data/processed/distfromincurs_masked.tif")
dist_frm_initial_m <- rast("data/processed/distfromincurs_masked.tif")

# Ensure all environmental variable rasters are "rasters" not "SpatRasters"
bioAUS_r <- raster::stack(bioAUS)

# Make a bioclim thing like the berthon et al. paper
bio_berthon <- bioAUS[[c(4,5,12,13,15)]]
bio_berthon_r <- rast(bio_berthon)

# Find annual sum of mean solar rad
srad_ann_sum <- app(sradAUS, fun = sum, na.rm = TRUE)
writeRaster(srad_ann_sum, "data/processed/Climate data/annual_sum_srad.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
srad_ann_sum <- rast("data/processed/Climate data/annual_sum_srad.tif")

# Forest cover
forAUS_wgs84_r <- rast("data/processed/Forest data/forestcovercode.tif")

# Running MaxEnt and evaluating outputs -----------------------------------

# Resample forest cover to the coarser resolutions of other rasters
forAUS_resampled <- resample(forAUS_wgs84_r, bioAUS, method = "near")
writeRaster(forAUS_resampled, "data/processed/Forest data/forAUS_resampled.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
forAUS_resampled <- rast("data/processed/Forest data/forAUS_resampled.tif")

rat2 <- levels(forAUS_resampled)[[1]]
rcl2 <- as.matrix(rat2[, c("ID", "COVER_CODE")])
cc_only_re <- classify(forAUS_resampled, rcl2)
cc_only_re <- as.factor(cc_only_re)
writeRaster(cc_only_re, "data/processed/Forest data/forAUS_covercodeonly_resampled.tif")
cc_only_re <- rast("data/processed/Forest data/forAUS_covercodeonly_resampled.tif")

# Convert terra SpatRaster to raster RasterLayer or RasterStack
cc_only_re_r <- raster(cc_only_re)
#bioAUS_r <- raster(bioAUS)
srad_ann_sum_r <- raster(srad_ann_sum)

# Stack rasters for MaxEnt input
env_rasts <- c(cc_only_re, bio_berthon, srad_ann_sum, dist_frm_initial_m)
env_rasts_r <- stack(env_rasts)


# Load in
bioAUS <- rast("data/raw/climate/wc2.1_country/AUS_wc2.1_30s_bio.tif")

dist_frm_initial_m <- rast("data/processed/distfromincurs_masked.tif")

cc_only_re <- rast("data/processed/Forest data/forAUS_covercodeonly_resampled.tif")

srad_ann_sum <- rast("data/processed/Climate data/annual_sum_srad.tif")

bio_berthon <- bioAUS[[c(4,5,12,13,15)]]

env_rasts <- c(cc_only_re, dist_frm_initial_m, srad_ann_sum, bio_berthon)

env_rasts_r <- stack(env_rasts)


```

## Maxent Modelling

```{r}
#| echo: false
set.seed(42)
bg <- randomPoints(env_rasts_r, n=10000)

# CHANGE THIS TO YOUR MAXENT PATH
maxent_path <- "~your/path/to/maxent/maxent.jar"

# Cross-validation for checking

five_model <- maxent(x = env_rasts_r, 
                p = occ_30sec_df, 
                a = bg, 
                factors = c("COVER_CODE"), 
                path = "outputs/data/maxent_output_fivefold", 
                args = c("-J", "-P", "product=false", "replicates=5", "hinge=false", "threshold=false"), 
                progpath = maxent_path)

# Final model
model <- maxent(x = env_rasts_r, 
                p = occ_30sec_df, 
                a = bg, 
                factors = c("COVER_CODE"), 
                path = "outputs/data/maxent_output_final", 
                args = c("-J", "-P", "product=false", "randomtestpoints=25", "replicates=1", "hinge=false", "threshold=false"), 
                progpath = maxent_path)

# Run prediction
pred <- predict(model, env_rasts_r)

writeRaster(pred, filename = "outputs/data/Predictions/maxent_prediction.tif")
```

### Visualising model

```{r}
pred <- rast("outputs/data/Predictions/maxent_prediction.tif")
pred_alb <- project(pred, "EPSG:3577")

# crop to the states shapefile
pred_alb_crop <- crop(pred_alb, states_alb)

# As a dataframe for gg
pred_df <- as.data.frame(pred_alb_crop, xy = TRUE)
colnames(pred_df) <- c("x", "y", "suitability")

# simplifying state lines
states_simplified <- st_simplify(states_alb, dTolerance = 1000)

# plot using gg
suit_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = pred_df, aes(x, y, fill = suitability)) +
  geom_sf(data = states_simplified, fill = NA, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.1, lineend = "round", linejoin = "round") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno",
    direction = -1,
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.05, 0.20, 0.50, 0.70, 1.00)),
    name = "Environmental\nsuitability"
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = TRUE) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
  location = "tr",
  which_north = "true",
  style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(
    text_size = 8,          # label font size (“N”)
    line_width = 1,         # thickness of arrow lines
    fill = c("grey40", "white")  # colors for arrow halves
  ),
  height = unit(1.5, "cm"),  # ⬅ increase arrow height
  width  = unit(1.5, "cm")   # ⬅ increase arrow width
) +
   theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +  # ⬅ increases base font size for entire plot
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),   # ⬅ legend title font
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),   # ⬅ legend labels font
    legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),      # ⬅ make colorbar taller
    legend.key.width  = unit(1.0, "cm")       # ⬅ make colorbar wider
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    barwidth = 1.2,  # adjust width
    barheight = 8,   # adjust height (in cm)
    title.position = "top"  # optional: move title above bar
  ))
suit_map
```

### TSS and Cohen's kappa

```{r}

# evaluating the model
eval_obj <- evaluate(p = occ_30sec_df, 
                     a = bg, 
                     model = model, 
                     x = env_rasts_r)

# Prepare coordinates
occ_coords <- occ_30sec_df[, c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude")]
names(occ_coords) <- c("x", "y")


# Extract predicted probabilities
pred_occ <- raster::extract(pred, occ_coords)
pred_bg <- raster::extract(pred, bg)

# Combine into a single presence/absence dataframe
df_pa <- data.frame(
  obs = c(rep(1, length(pred_occ)), rep(0, length(pred_bg))),  # 1 = presence, 0 = background
  pred = c(pred_occ, pred_bg)  # predicted probability from raster
)

# Determine TSS-maximizing threshold
eval_obj <- evaluate(p = occ_coords, a = bg, model = model, x = env_rasts_r)
tss_threshold <- threshold(eval_obj, "spec_sens")

# Convert probabilities to binary using threshold
df_pa$pred_bin <- ifelse(df_pa$pred >= tss_threshold, 1, 0)

# Build confusion matrix manually
conf_matrix <- table(Observed = df_pa$obs, Predicted = df_pa$pred_bin)
conf_matrix
# Should have exactly 2 rows (obs 0/1) and 2 columns (pred 0/1)

# Calculate TSS
sens <- conf_matrix[2,2] / sum(conf_matrix[2,])  # TP / (TP + FN)
spec <- conf_matrix[1,1] / sum(conf_matrix[1,])  # TN / (TN + FP)
TSS <- sens + spec - 1
TSS

# Calculate Cohen's Kappa
kappa_val <- Kappa(conf_matrix)
kappa_val

```
